source: src/util/jsonDeepEqual.ts jsonDeepEqual; src/util/fetchConfigurationGuard.ts tryParseJson; src/util/pathTenantLoc.ts pathTenantLocFromL3Path
title: Pure helpers: jsonDeepEqual, tryParseJson and dotted tenant-name parsing
scenario: 1) Compare {a:1,b:{c:[1,2]}} with {b:{c:[1,2]},a:1}. 2) Compare [1,2] vs [2,1], [1] vs [1,2], [] vs {}, [] vs null, {} vs []. 3) Compare null vs {}, null vs null, 1 vs '1', 0 vs false, 'a' vs 'a', 1 vs 1.0. 4) Compare {a:1} vs {a:1,b:2}, {a:1,b:undefined} vs {a:1,c:undefined}, {a:undefined} vs {}. 5) tryParseJson on '{"a":1}', '', '{bad', 'null', '0'. 6) pathTenantLocFromL3Path with tenant 'abc.def-1.reltio.tenant' and env 'My Env.reltio.environment', and a path with two .reltio.tenant segments.
expected: 1) Returns true; reordered keys are equal. 2) All false; array vs object never equal, even when both empty. 3) null===null and identical primitives true; null vs object and differing types false. 4) Differing key counts or names false; key-with-undefined is not equal to a missing key. 5) Valid JSON returns the value (null and 0 included); empty or malformed text returns undefined. 6) tenantId 'abc.def-1', environmentName 'My Env'; with two tenant segments the first match is used.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce/versionsDiffer, syncOnce needSkills/needPacks, syncOnce stamp merge, syncOnce pathExists checks, syncReltioAgentAssets {force}
title: Agent asset sync stamp logic: bump, skip, independent versions, restore, force
scenario: 1) Stamp skillsBundleVersion 20, bundle says 21 with a changed SKILL.md and a stray file in .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default; sync. 2) Sync twice with unchanged versions, marker files in skills/default and velocity-packs, count fs writes and deletes on the second run. 3) Stamp skills 20 and packs 1, bundle bumps only skills to 21, marker in velocity-packs; sync and read .sync-state.json. 4) Fresh sync, delete velocity-packs while the stamp stays current; sync again. 5) Fresh sync, edit a file in skills/default, run syncReltioAgentAssets(context, {force:true}).
expected: 1) skills/default is deleted and recopied (stray file gone) and the stamp becomes 21. 2) Neither folder is deleted or recopied; markers survive and no managed-layer writes occur. 3) skills/default recopied, velocity-packs untouched, stamp shows skills 21 and packs 1, ownedAgentFiles retained. 4) velocity-packs is recopied from resources/velocity-packs; skills/default is not rewritten. 5) The edited managed file is restored to bundled content and the stamp stays at bundled versions; a non-forced equal-stamp run leaves the edit alone.

title: KeyedDebouncer: independent keys, last-callback coalescing, cancel and dispose
scenario: 1) With a 20ms delay, schedule keys A and B inside the window with separate callbacks. 2) Schedule key A three times quickly with callbacks 1, 2, 3 and wait past the delay. 3) Schedule A and B, cancel(A), cancel('unknown'), then dispose() with a new pending key; wait past the delay; re-schedule after cancel.
expected: 1) Both callbacks run exactly once; the first key's work is not dropped by the second. 2) Only callback 3 runs, once, measured from the last schedule call. 3) Cancelled and disposed work never runs, B runs if not disposed, cancel on an unknown key and double dispose do not throw, and re-schedule after cancel works.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts reltioHeaders / RELTIO_CLIENT_HEADER; src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce early returns
title: Contracts: Reltio client header set and agent-assets file early returns
scenario: 1) Capture headers for listTenants, fetchL3Configuration, putL3Configuration, searchEntities, verifyMatches and validateEnvironment (no token). 2) Run sync with no resources/reltio-agent-assets.json, one missing velocityPacksBundleVersion, invalid JSON, and no workspace folders.
expected: 1) listTenants lacks 'xxx-client'; the others send xxx-client: true; Authorization 'Bearer tok' when a token is given and absent for validateEnvironment; Content-Type on POST/PUT. 2) Each returns {conflicts:[],invalid:[]} without throwing and creates no .reltio/reltio-agent directory or stamp.

title: Fetch-configuration guard: unpublished changes and remote-vs-baseline fail closed
scenario: 1) hasUnpublishedLocalChangesFromText with baseline undefined; baseline '{bad'; local '{bad' with valid baseline; identical JSON with different whitespace/key order; differing JSON. 2) remoteMatchesBaseline with unparsable baseline, unparsable remote, equal JSON, and different JSON.
expected: 1) Undefined or unparsable baseline or local gives true; formatting-only differences give false; a real value difference gives true. 2) Unparsable either side gives false (never claims a match); equal gives true; different gives false; protects the overwrite-remote confirmation.

source: src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts syncOnce, copyDirectory; src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts syncAgentSkills, resolveSkills
title: Skill override layer and opt-out: never written, lands in install, owned paths only
scenario: 1) With skills/workspace/<playbook>/SKILL.md, a team-only skill folder and a loose note, run fresh, version-bump, forced and install=false syncs; snapshot the tree bytes before and after each. 2) Override match-groups-from-concept (same name), sync, compare .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default/<playbook>/SKILL.md with .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. 3) Sync with reltio.installAgentSkills true, add a user file in .claude/skills and a team rule in .claude/rules, set the setting false and sync.
expected: 1) skills/workspace is byte-identical after every run, including opt-out. 2) The managed default copy keeps bundled content; the installed .claude copy shows the override content. 3) All stamp-owned paths vanish, ownedAgentFiles becomes [], user files remain, and the .reltio/reltio-agent managed layer is still synced.

title: Skill sync reports conflicts and invalid skills instead of overwriting or substituting
scenario: 1) Pre-create .claude/skills/<bundled-name>/ with user content not in the stamp, then sync. 2) Skills with no SKILL.md, missing name, name with uppercase, double hyphen or 65 chars, description over 1024 chars, and an override renaming the default; assert skillProblem and resolveSkills output.
expected: 1) Report.conflicts lists the path, user content is unchanged, and the path is absent from ownedAgentFiles in the stamp. 2) Each case yields one invalid message naming playbook and reason; the skill is not installed and the default is not silently substituted; a 64-char name and 1024-char description are accepted.

source: src/api/reltioClient.ts listTenants/fetchConfigurationHistory, HTTP status mapping, putL3Configuration/formatPutConfigurationFailureMessage, countEntities
title: Reltio client response validation, status mapping, error formatting, count fallback
scenario: 1) Stub 200 with an object instead of an array, a null row, rows missing tenantId, updatedBy, timestamp or configuration, and a numeric timestamp. 2) For fetchL3Configuration, putL3Configuration, searchEntities, countEntities, verifyMatches stub 401, 403, 500 with tenantId 'a/b c'. 3) Stub 400 with {severity,errorMessage,errorCode,errorDetailMessage}, detail equal to message, only errorCode, plain text, empty body, non-JSON starting with '{'. 4) countEntities with POST 405 then GET 200 returning '42', '{"total":7}', '{"total":"9"}', 5, '{"x":1}'.
expected: 1) ReltioApiError with the documented message per case and statusCode 200; numeric timestamp stringified; valid rows kept in order. 2) 401 gives 'Unauthorized (401)'; others '<op> failed: HTTP <n>'; URL contains 'a%2Fb%20c'. 3) Intro has HTTP status and code; duplicate detail omitted; code-only adds a documentation hint; empty gives 'Put configuration failed (HTTP 400).'; invalid JSON falls back to raw text. 4) GET fallback returns 42, 7, 9, 5; unexpected shape throws 'unexpected response shape'; 401 after fallback still maps to Unauthorized.

title: Path and tree-node tenant resolvers reject invalid shapes
scenario: 1) pathTenantLocFromL3Path with no tenant segment, tenant segment first (index 0), tenant preceded by a plain folder, empty string, and trailing or doubled separators on a valid path. 2) tenantIdFromTreeContext with undefined, null, 'str', 42, {tenantId:''}, {id:'tenant:Dev'}, {id:'tenant:Dev/'}, {contextValue:'other',label:'x'}, {contextValue:'reltio.tenant',label:''}.
expected: 1) Returns undefined for invalid shapes; trailing or doubled separators on a valid path still parse. 2) All return undefined; empty tenantId returns undefined directly without falling through to other branches.

title: Reltio client URL hardening and redirect protection for bearer tokens
scenario: 1) listTenants with stubbed fetch for 'https://user:pw@test.reltio.com', 'https://test.reltio.com/evil', 'test.reltio.com?x=1', 'https://test.reltio.com#f'. 2) Bases 'TEST.RELTIO.COM', 'reltio.com.evil.com', 'evilreltio.com', 'test.reltio.com:8443', ' //test.reltio.com ', 'test.reltio.com/'. 3) Stub fetch to capture init, call fetchL3Configuration('test.reltio.com','t','tok'); also reject with a redirect TypeError.
expected: 1) UntrustedHostError for each; fetch never called; message does not echo the password. 2) Upper-case and trailing slash accepted; lookalikes rejected; leading slashes and whitespace trimmed; resulting URL has no double slash. 3) init.redirect === 'error'; Authorization only on the first request; redirect failure surfaces as 'Network error: ...' with no second fetch.

title: Agent sync never touches files outside owned paths and .reltio
scenario: 1) Workspace with user AGENTS.md without markers, an unterminated block marker, customer .cursor rules and .github workflows; run sync as cursor, vscode and other hosts.
expected: 1) User files byte-identical; unterminated block leaves the file unchanged; only stamp-owned paths, legacy-marker files and emptied parent folders are removed.

title: Reltio client timeouts, bounded response reads and truncated error bodies
scenario: 1) Stub fetch that honors AbortSignal and never resolves with timeoutMs=20; another throws TypeError('fetch failed') with cause.message 'ECONNREFUSED'. 2) Fake responses: Content-Length above limit; stream over maxBytes without header; reader that never resolves (timeoutMs=20); body without getReader over limit; normal small body. 3) verifyMatches stub 500 with a 50,000-char body, and 401.
expected: 1) Hang gives 'Request timed out after 20ms: <url>'; network failure gives 'Network error: fetch failed (ECONNREFUSED)'; timer cleared in both. 2) Oversize gives 'too large'; stall gives 'Reading the response timed out'; reader cancelled; small body returned as UTF-8. 3) responseBody length <= 12,000, message 'Verify matches failed: HTTP 500'; 401 gives Unauthorized without body.

title: Cross-platform paths: POSIX and Windows separators, nested skills, CRLF frontmatter
scenario: 1) pathTenantLocFromL3Path with 'C:\ws\Dev.reltio.environment\t1.reltio.tenant\l3.json', '/home/u/Dev.reltio.environment/t1.reltio.tenant/l3.json' and a mixed-separator path. 2) syncAgentSkills with a skill containing nested references/ files and a CRLF SKILL.md, plus a Windows-drive-style workspace URI via the stub.
expected: 1) All return {environmentName:'Dev', tenantId:'t1'}; both / and backslash split the path. 2) Nested files land at expected relative paths, owned entries use forward slashes, CRLF frontmatter parses name and description.

source: src/util/jsonDeepEqual.ts jsonDeepEqual; src/workspace/agentSkillDiscovery.ts converge; src/workspace/reltioAgentSync.ts copyDirectory
title: Scale limits: deep jsonDeepEqual and idempotent large skills-tree resync
scenario: 1) Build two identical 1000-level nested objects and a 100k-element array pair; compare. 2) Seed memory-fs with all real skills/reltio-default files, sync twice, count fs writes on the second run and measure elapsed time.
expected: 1) Returns true without stack overflow and within a few seconds; documents the recursion depth assumption for real L3 configs. 2) Second run writes 0 managed-skill files (converge writes only differing files) and finishes within a few seconds in memory-fs.
